items.abstract_or_text: ## What's Changed * Update version post 0.19.8 release by @loadams in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8871 * Update to filter out version.txt from PR gates. by @loadams in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8872 * Skip the accelerator-only CPU optimizer tests on the cpu accelerator by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8836 * Keep Yuan's o_proj bias whole on every rank and describe it as replicated by @Achyuthan-S in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8857 * Expect AutoTP to keep a row-parallel output head tied to the embedding by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8855 * Add Triton kernels for vocab-parallel logprobs, entropy and KL by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8838 * Fix numerical stability in Triton masked softmax by @arcusbuilds in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8782 * Add RVV vectorized FP32 kernel to CPU Adam by @zhangjian29 in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8817 * [OPSD] Request last-position logits only in HybridEngine rollout prefill by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8839 * docs: fix 30 dead links across README, docs pages, tutorials and posts by @pratikgx in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8688 * docs: fix remaining dead links in the Chinese README, tutorials and blog by @woodforestsen in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8894 * Bump modal-torch-latest CI Python from 3.10 to 3.12 by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8902 * [AffineIR] Plan expert transfers from the live runtime placement by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8800 * Set TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS=1 in modal CI sandbox to stop 300s test timeouts by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8914 * Fix scalar parameter byte-view broadcasts by @adenzhou1350 in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8642 * Honor fp16 hysteresis in the ZeRO stage 0 fp16 optimizers by @vineethsaivs in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8647 * Strip ANSI color codes before parsing FAILED lines in cpu-multi-triage by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8882 * Bump AWS capacity-fallback Python from 3.10.13 to 3.12.14 by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8921 * AutoEP: fused Triton kernel for the clamped expert activations by @pengdurice in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8652 * Keep fp32 masters on ZeRO-1 and ZeRO-2 when a resume skips optimizer state by @sfc-gh-truwase in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8891 * Skip accelerator sync for unprofiled comm ops by @guptaishaan in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8795 * Fix performance regression caused by comms logger and bug in comms_logger.enabled by @hwchen2017 in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8909 * Use nvtx's module-level API so NVTX domain ranges work on older nvtx releases by @hwchen2017 in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8900 * [AffineIR] Affine storage maps for live ZeRO parameters and optimizer states by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8885 * Add a v1 multi-rank CPU suite (manual dispatch first) by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8926 * [AutoEP] Ensure consistent order of partition groups in all-gather when ZeRO-3 by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8876 * Fix race between folded checkpoint load and metadata drop in AutoEP+AutoTP test by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8943 * Check where column-split pieces write in a shard by @Achyuthan-S in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8922 ## New Contributors * @arcusbuilds made their first contribution in Use up to 256 threads per threadgroup and bound-check the tail. * metal : split GLU rows across threadgroups A GLU row ran on one threadgroup, so single-row decode used a single threadgroup for the whole op. items.abstract_or_text: sycl : vectorize reordered-layout dequantization stores (Q4_0, K-quants, IQ3, MXFP4) (#30976) * sycl : widen reordered q4_0 dequantization stores The reordered-layout Q4_0 conversion kernel processed one qs byte per work-item with two scalar stores, strided 16 elements apart. Give it the same treatment the Q8_0 kernel got in #30775: a flat sycl::range launch with four qs bytes (8 outputs) per work-item inside one 32-element block and two vec stores. Same float math and rounding as the scalar kernel; output is bit-identical. The existing k % QK4_0 == 0 assert guarantees whole 32-element blocks, so the k/8 launch covers every row exactly. The now-unreferenced scalar reorder kernel is removed. Arc Pro B70, primed prefill (prefill after decode on a reorder-installed tensor): +6.4% to +7.3% pp512/pp2048 on Q4_0 models (tested up to 27B dense); fresh-layout prefill and decode unchanged; PPL within run noise. * sycl : vectorize reordered q4_K dequantization stores The reordered-layout Q4_K conversion kernel already loads its quantized inputs through sycl::vec but writes the dequantized results with scalar stores. Build the results in a vec register and emit two vector stores instead. Same per-element math; output is bit-identical. items.abstract_or_text: ggml-openvino: slice view inputs of SCALE (#31334) SCALE now accepts a src0 view with arbitrary row strides. translate_scale used the raw input, and on the dynamic path a VIEW translates to its whole source tensor, so a strided view input scaled the entire source. The model output then had the source's size, and copying it back overran the result buffer, which crashes test-backend-ops on the SCALE view cases. Slice the input with process_view_input_new, as the other translators do. items.abstract_or_text: common, mtmd: bound control vector layer indices and M-RoPE position loops (#31336) * common: bound control vector layer indices by the model layer count A direction tensor layer index is parsed from the tensor name with no upper bound, and the buffer size and write offset are computed in int. A large index overflows both, so the accumulation writes before the start of the buffer. Pass the model layer count to the loader, reject indices above it like the existing zero index check, and compute the sizes in size_t. * mtmd: fill M-RoPE positions by whole merge tiles The position loops of the Qwen-VL, GLM, PaddleOCR and Qwen2.5-VL encoders hardcode a 2x2 merge inside a stride of n_merge, so a patch grid that is not a multiple of the merge writes past the positions buffer. Iterate over whole merge tiles with n_merge inner steps, which bounds the writes by the patch count and gives the same positions on aligned grids. PaddleOCR also requires a merge aligned image at graph build, as the Qwen-VL family already does. **Website:** - **Attestations:** - **macOS/iOS:** - [macOS Apple Silicon (arm64)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b11972/llama-b11972-bin-macos-arm64.tar.gz) -
